content.article: Longfu88 opens its promotions with the Casino Welcome Bonus: up to €2,088 at 188% plus 18 Free Spins, rolled over 25 times on deposit plus bonus with Free Spins winnings at 40 times. A short Longfu bonus guide follows: families, sports offers, cashback and rebates. The page is for Singapore readers aged 18 and over.

Longfu88 Bonus Types in One Paragraph

Starters: the Casino Welcome Bonus, a live variant (Live Casino Welcome Bonus) and a crypto variant (Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus). Top-ups: Casino Weekly Reload with Casino Weekend Reload. Returns are the Casino Weekly Cashback, the Unlimited Casino Rebate and the Live Casino Cashback. Sports bonuses and a rewards area sit beside these. Each Longfu88 offer has separate terms and gets switched on in My Bonuses.

Welcome Offer Basics

Aimed at newly registered players, the Longfu88 welcome bonus is the Casino Welcome Bonus. Its 188% match tops out at €2,088 and brings 18 Free Spins along, and the first qualifying deposit that earns it begins at €50. A single welcome offer is allowed per account at Longfu88.

Sports Bonuses and the Odds Rule

Longfu88 gives its sportsbook a separate set of bonuses, three of which carry the same low wagering multiple.

Sportsbook offer Match Minimum Rollover
Sport First Deposit Bonus €1,888 cap, 100% match €50 deposit 8x applied to deposit + bonus
Sport Weekly Reload Bonus €2,500 cap, 50% match €50 deposit 8x applied to deposit + bonus
Sport Weekend Reload Bonus €3,750 cap, 50% match €50 deposit 8x applied to deposit + bonus

Bets must be settled and qualifying to count toward wagering. A single bet needs 2.00 or more, and odds per accumulator selection must be 1.50 or more. Neither voided bets nor cashed-out bets qualify. Validity is 30 days for all three. Parlay Boost is separate: qualifying accumulators earn as much as 100% extra winnings.

Cashback and VIP Rates

Longfu88 runs two cashback offers. The Casino Weekly Cashback returns a share of each week's net casino losses, at most 10%. Its maximum is €6,988, and the smallest payout is €4.5. Weeks run Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 UTC. A four-week cycle starts with an opt-in. Withdrawal needs 10x wagering on the cashback, counted on real-money casino bets only. Bonus funds do not count. The second offer is the Live Casino Cashback with 25%, to a ceiling of €850. It needs an opt-in, then activation in My Bonuses. Wagering on its credited cashback is 10x. Rate and ceiling follow VIP level:

Measure VIP Bronze VIP Silver VIP Gold VIP Platinum VIP Diamond
Cashback 2% 4% 6% 8% 10%
Maximum €1,888 €2,388 €2,988 €3,988 €6,988

Daily Rebates

Rebates are not cashback, because they follow wagering rather than net losses. In the Unlimited Casino Rebate the rate is 0.9%, and in the Unlimited Live Casino Rebate it is 1.0%. Both apply to qualifying real-money bets, once settled, in their game category. Longfu88 pays the rebate into the rewards balance each day. Its credited amount needs 1x wagering.

Using Offers Responsibly

Offer eligibility at Longfu88 starts at age 18, and gambling is meant only for places where it is lawful. Validity, maximum bet and wagering terms deserve a read before an offer is accepted. Gamblers Anonymous, GamCare and Gambling Therapy are the support organisations the casino names.
